vocab.definition: Pope/Tataru AGP vocabulary; column j = vocab ID j = FASTA header embed{j+1} in seqs_.07_embed.fasta (embed26727 = <unk>, excluded)

matrix_values: raw read counts (float32); relative abundance is derived in the encoding layer
asv_overlap_note: asv_overlap_frac_idmatch = fraction of the cohort's distinct vocab IDs that occur in AGP-IBD. It is near 1 by construction because the curators mapped HMP2/HV ASVs onto the AGP vocabulary and dropped non-matching ones; it does not measure shift. Fig 2 uses asv_overlap_frac_pope_blast (Pope et al. 2025 §3.2, BLAST >=99% id, e-value 1e-20, on raw ASVs) - their measurement, not ours (decision at S1, 2026-09-27).
subject_id: none available; AGP-IBD 5-fold CV is stratified by label but NOT grouped by patient
